name: Miho Sayashi
source:
Separated from her parents at a very young age, her survival had always been dependent on her older brother. She may seem excitable, but she only finds courage when Yu is around. Her true feelings are unknown to anyone except the diary she kept, which was off-limits even to her brother and closest friends.

[From [url=http://exogenesisvn.com/characters/]the official website[/url]]
